goldAudit.verificationEvidence: shortlist-retention.json (produced by scripts/verify-jev-binary-holdout.mjs before any live Jev/OpenJev API call)

disjointness.statement: XADMaster is a distinct Mach-O image from every previously evaluated holdout binary; zero (class, field) pairs in this holdout's gold set appear in the gold sets of the Sparkle, OpenEmu, or 54-case holdouts.
